items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Not spotted at practice
items.description:
Tuten (ankle/foot) was not spotted during the portion of Tuesday's practice open to the media, according to Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com.

items.title: Hunter Henry: Status uncertain for Week 9
items.description:
Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he had no update on Henry's (foot) status heading into Sunday's game against the Packers, Karen Guregian of MassLive.com reports. "I don't have any expectations yet," Vrabel said of Henry. "It's kind of how he responds here. He wasn't able to finish the [Week 8] game. So we'll see where he is, and I know Hunter will do everything he can to get back to help us."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Middling numbers in Week 8 loss
items.description:
Darnold completed 17 of 34 passes for 188 yards with two touchdowns and one interception while adding two rushes for 20 yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

items.title: Zach Charbonnet: Nine touches in season debut
items.description:
Charbonnet (knee) rushed six times for 23 yards and brought in three of four targets for six yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Gains 37 total yards in return
